texto: As of Oct. 30, 2026, Vistra had hedged approximately 100% of its expected generation volumes for 2026, approximately 98% for 2027, and approximately 78% for 2028.
Vistra executed ~$6.7 billion in share repurchases since November 2021.
Vistra had ~339 million shares outstanding, representing a ~30% reduction of the amount of the shares outstanding on Nov. 2, 2021.
GAAP third quarter 2026 Net Income of $1,140 million, including an unrealized gain from hedges expected to settle in future years of $559 million.
Achieved more than 50% growth in Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA 1 to $2,378 million for the quarter compared to third quarter 2025.
Raised the midpoint and narrowed the range for 2026 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA 1 to $7.1 billion to $7.5 billion and Ongoing Operations Adjusted FCFbG 1 to $4.3 billion to $4.7 billion.
Initiated 2027 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA 1 and Ongoing Operations Adjusted FCFbG 1 guidance ranges of $7.7 billion to $8.5 billion and $4.3 billion to $5.1 billion, respectively.
Board authorized an additional $1.5 billion of share repurchases, which is expected to be utilized by year-end 2028.
In October 2026, closed the acquisition of Cogentrix Energy, consisting of approximately 5,500 MW of natural gas-fueled generation capacity.
Commenced operations of our 405 MW Pulaski Solar Facility in Illinois, under a power purchase agreement with Microsoft, and our 100 MW Deer Creek Solar & Energy Storage Facility in California.
Announced a 20-year 207 MW power purchase agreement with New Era Energy and Digital at our Odessa combined cycle gas plant in Texas.

nuevos: If electricity demand does not grow at the rate expected, or if we are unable to execute on large load offtake opportunities, including under long-term power purchase or offtake agreements that we have entered into, our financial performance, growth opportunities, and stock price could be adversely impacted.

Our liquidity needs could be difficult to satisfy, particularly during times of uncertainty in the financial markets or during times of significant fluctuation in commodity prices, and we may be unable to access capital on favorable terms or at all in the future, which could have a material adverse effect on us. We currently maintain a mix of investment grade and non-investment grade credit ratings that could negatively affect our ability to access capital on favorable terms or result in higher collateral requirements, particularly if our credit ratings were to be downgraded in the future.

We may not be able to consummate the Cogentrix Transactions on the anticipated terms, on the anticipated timeline, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operation and stock price.
Following the completion of the Cogentrix Transactions, we may not realize the anticipated synergies and other expected benefits of the Cogentrix Transactions on the anticipated timeline or at all.

If electricity demand does not grow at the rate expected, or if we are unable to execute on large load offtake opportunities, our financial performance, growth opportunities, and stock price could be adversely impacted.
